rationale: New module sandboxed_tool.py extends but does not replace existing controlled_execution.py. Existing FakeToolAdapter and ToolPort Protocol remain unchanged.
Windows taskkill /F /T is available without additional dependencies. Job Objects via pywin32 would be stronger but require an optional dependency.
note: Document that taskkill is best-effort; extreme cases may leave orphaned grandchildren.

rationale: Only pass environment variables whose names are in both plan.environment_names and policy.environment_allowlist. Add PATH (all platforms) and SYSTEMROOT (Windows) for basic process function.
Use threading.Thread for concurrent stdout/stderr reads to avoid deadlock. Redact and truncate per-chunk. Python's subprocess.PIPE with threads is the stdlib pattern.
FailureInjectingAdapter extends SandboxedToolAdapter with boolean flags for each failure mode. Simple, explicit, testable.
We re-resolve paths immediately before process start, narrowing the TOCTOU window but not eliminating it. Platform-level TOCTOU defense requires OS sandboxing which is out of scope.
note: Document in threat model that TOCTOU race exists between re-resolve and Popen.
